title: The Sentiment Problem: A Critical Survey towards Deconstructing Sentiment Analysis
findings: This paper is a critical survey of 189 papers on sentiment analysis (SA). It investigates the sociotechnical aspects of SA, its various definitions, applications, and the models/datasets used. The paper highlights biases in SA models related to race, age, and disability but does not contain any analysis, measurements, or findings related to religion, faith, or specific religious groups.
